title: Surreal Mystic Portrait
description: A black and white line drawing of an elderly man with a large mustache, wearing a beret and round glasses, holds a cigarette while looking toward a large stylized eye. The composition features swirling smoke-like forms containing multiple smaller eyes, faces, a crystal ball with a figure inside, and purple lavender-like flowers at the bottom.
